name: Slave’s Rage
body:
Some elders say The Rage was part of how The Masters controlled our race, and we should reject it.

Prerequisite(s): Qit’ar, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): Once per day, if you take at least 4 points of electricity damage, you may use rage (as the barbarian class feature) in the next round. For every four levels past 1st, you may increase the number of rage rounds available by 1, provided you also take another 4 points of electrical damage per increase round of rage, to a maximum of 5 rounds at 17th level.
